hello all
i had the idea a month or so ago of setting up a website selling kids clothes and stuff - well i have enlisted the help of a mate who is doing the design and stuff.
i was a bit bored so i have been looking into building websites and have had a go at one selling adult toys -
i have shopped online for toys and bits before but i always got put off by the "hardcore" toys and ended up in ann summers - whose range i think is getting a bit limited.
hopefully my website will appeal to all women whether first timers or women looking for something new.
i havent finished adding all the products yet and i am trying to source some funky toiletry/sex toy bags like the rampant rabbit case in ann summers but i havent found anything yet.
i am also adding a coupon/giftcard manager so will be able to offer all JP members a discount - im looking to go live with it by monday morning (unless you point out a huge whopper of a mistake/error)
can you tell me what you think?? if i should add stuff or remove stuff etc....
thanks ladies
esther
